flat.$description: Tables, dividers, code blocks — explicit square corners.

control.$description: Buttons, inputs, selects, tabs, tooltips. Brandable via brand.radius.control (Brand A 4px, Brand B 8px).

container.$description: Cards, panels, alerts, modals, popovers, dialogs. Brandable via brand.radius.container (Brand A 12px, Brand B 16px).

checkbox.$description: Component-scoped and shared across brands (NOT brandable): the Checkbox box. Stays 4px so a 16px checkbox remains visibly square — distinct from Radio — even when a brand rounds radius.control.

full.$description: Pills, avatars, circular icons/status dots. Aliases the `radius.max` primitive (Figma name: radius/full — see radius.max's description for why the code-side primitive name differs).
